reference.kind: norm: researched local-neighbourhood figures; no generator run sets a range
reference.point: the default galaxy's reference solar position (8.2 kpc, in the plane), each population picked by its density there

sources.RECONS: RECONS census of objects nearer than 10 parsecs, Henry et al., data of 2018-04-12 (read 2026-10-28): 378 stars of which 21 white dwarfs (A 4, F 7, G 19, K 44, M 283), 50 brown dwarfs, 317 systems (232 single, 66 double, 14 triple, 3 quadruple, 2 quintuple), multiplicity rate 27%
sources.Mamajek: Mamajek, Number Densities of Stars of Different Types in the Solar Vicinity (read 2026-10-28): fraction of stars O 5e-7, B 3.9e-4, A 6.0e-3, F 0.031, G 0.041, K 0.129, M 0.725 (0.687 from the RECONS 10 pc density), white dwarfs 0.059
sources.multiplicity: Duchene and Kraus 2013 (ARA&A 51:269): M dwarfs 26 +/- 3%; Raghavan et al. 2010 (ApJS 190:1): solar-type 46% with 56% single, 33% double, 8% triple, 3% higher (44 +/- 2% in Duchene and Kraus); Moe and Di Stefano 2017 (ApJS 230:15) Table 13: A and late B 0.59 +/- 0.11. Recalled, not reopened (tier T2/T3); the same figures tuning.py quotes

anomalies.GEN.898: A stars are 0.15% of stars against 0.6% (Mamajek) to 1.1% (RECONS): the A/F edge moved to 7200 K (F0V) and the share rose from 0.11%, the rest is the recent star formation. At the reference solar position (the inter-arm minimum) the mix is 87% old, 12% intermediate, 0.1% young, which is the disk history of the Milky Way-like galaxy: its present rate over its mean is 0.27 to 0.38 against the observed 0.20, and its B share 0.02 to 0.05% against 0.04%, so more recent stars would break both; a constant history gives A 0.3%, and the observed figure is 4 stars of 378 (a 95% interval of 0.3% to 2.7%)
anomalies.GEN.943: G stars are 2.9% of stars against 5.0% (RECONS) and 4.1% (Mamajek): the letter edges moved to the midpoints of the Pecaut and Mamajek dwarf sequence (G from 5,325 to 5,990 K, was 5,200 to 6,000; train 3, epoch 125), so fewer stars fall in G; Star 1 decides whether the edge or the star mix is the fault
anomalies.TEST.473: The A0V companion rate is 0.7456 against the norm edge 0.7367 (0.70 plus the draws' tolerance): arrived with train 3 (epoch 125), one cell 1.2 points over its edge; Star 2 and Star 1 look at the companion draw
